articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
articles.snippet: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

articles.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
articles.snippet: The Intercontinental Exchange-backed venture said it has confirmed 113 assets for listing as trading begins, following a wave of objections from companies initially picked for inclusion.

articles.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
articles.snippet: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.

articles.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
articles.snippet: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.

articles.title: China's Z.ai Says Its New AI Model Can Think Like One Four Times Its Size
articles.snippet: GLM-5.4 uses a looping architecture to squeeze more reasoning power from fewer parameters, challenging the expensive approach favored by American AI giants.
